newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turks ban livestock imports for three months.
newsitem.headline: Turks ban livestock imports for three months.

text.p: Turkey has banned imports of livestock for three months from August 1 in an effort to boost the local breeding and animal husbandry sectors, Agriculture Minister Mustafa Tasar said on Thursday.
"Livestock imports have been banned for three months from August 1, 1997," Tasar was quoted as saying by the state-run Anatolian news agency.
"Our aim is to protect our breeders and animal husbandry sector by enhancing domestic breeds," he said.
He said the government was working on a plan to promote livestock breeding and milk production.
"Turkey aims at taking its place among the livestock exporting countries," he said.
He did not give other details.
